core.scope: Structural and mathematical reconstruction of the organizational grammar in Plato's Atlantis account, not proof of historical Atlantis.

epistemic_controls: Keep Platonic textual measurements separate from derived discretizations.

core.transformation_axis: The canal spine is a transform axis between radial and linear order (Session Synthesis, p. 24, item 114).
core.testable_output: The map is judged partly by the territory its operators actually produce (Session Synthesis, p. 24, item 115).
